integrity: The proof uses only the printed differential equations, translation invariance of the passive bone-mass coordinate, and exact integration over a cell period. The motivating full text and two close Komarova-family sources were inspected for the equation structure and the scope of their stability analyses.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a structural statement about the passive bone-mass coordinate and does not assert that the motivating paper's numerical trajectories are incorrectly integrated.
The cycle-closure condition is exact, but the net flux of each plotted periodic trajectory was not reconstructed numerically.
Convergence of bone mass along a stable cell transient requires integrability of the bone-mass flux; the theorem does not quantify that transient for every parameter set.
The result does not apply unchanged to bone-remodeling models with feedback from bone density into the cell equations.
title: Passive bone mass creates a neutral direction and an exact cycle-closure law
